subject: Proposal: Convert Ryan Garcia (Contractor) to FTE — comp and headcount request
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Convert Ryan Garcia (Contractor) to FTE — comp and headcount request

Hi Dylan / Laura,

Following our discussion last week, People Ops is proposing a conversion package for Ryan Garcia (contractor with Contractors Inc.) to move to a full-time SWE II role on the Platform team. Below is the recommended package and asks so we can proceed with an official offer and headcount allocation.

Summary of recommendation:
- Role: Software Engineer II (Platform) — IC track
- Proposed start date (tentative): 2026-07-13
- Base salary: $160,000 annual (target at lower-mid of band)
- Annual bonus: 10% (at target)
- Equity: 0.02% RSU grant (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
- Sign-on: $7,500 (to offset lost contractor benefits during notice)
- Headcount: 1 FTE conversion (no net new headcount request — converting contractor line)

Rationale:
- Ryan has been with the org for 14 months through Contractors Inc. and has consistently met delivery milestones on KV cache and batching work.
- Market comp data (attached comp_packet_ryan_garcia.pdf) supports $155–170k range for this role in our region.
- Converting reduces long-term vendor spend and improves knowledge retention.

Asks:
1) Manager approval of the proposed comp package (Dylan) — please confirm base and sign-on.
2) Headcount approval from People/Finance (Laura) — confirm we can convert the contractor slot into an FTE within current FY headcount.
3) If approved, People Ops will prepare the draft offer (attached) and coordinate with contingent payroll to close out contractor billing.

Attachments: comp_packet_ryan_garcia.pdf, draft_offer_ryan_garcia.docx, headcount_approval_form.xlsx

Happy to hop on a quick 15-min sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
People Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

--
Contractor context and vendor billing: see attached headcount_approval_form.xlsx for current spend vs. FTE run-rate projections.

Subject: Re: Proposal: Convert Ryan Garcia (Contractor) to FTE — comp and headcount request

Monica, thanks for the clear packet. Quick notes from my side:

- I'm supportive of an offer in the $160k range for base. Ryan's paired work on the caching project has been high-impact; his ramp time will be minimal.
- Question on equity — is 0.02% standard for SWE II in our slate? That feels a touch light compared to peers who joined from similar vendors. Can we consider 0.03% or a slightly larger RSU grant instead of a higher base?
- Sign-on of $7,500 is reasonable given notice and benefits gap, but I'd prefer a $10k sign-on if budget allows.
- Start date 7/13 works but Ryan notes he has two weeks of contractor obligations through 7/2; he could start part-time earlier if desired.

Ryan (cc'd) — if you're comfortable with the timeline above, we'll aim to get approvals this week.

Dylan Brooks
Staff Engineer, Platform
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
